lines.en: I trudge forward over the mud.

lines.zh: 棕色的黏土和土一个色
lines.en: Brown clay matches the earth.
I go slowly, but my feet are sure.
I walk along the field ridge.
My boot soles are caked with dirt.
I keep to the back of the line.
Each step kicks up dust.
I walk toward that tree.
I step around a puddle.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看队伍的前头
lines.en: I look up toward the head of the line.
I hurry two steps to keep up.
I shift my stick to the other hand.
I crouch and wipe my face.
My clay has dried and cracked a little.
I brush the dirt off my shoulder.
I'm waiting for a sign up front.
The tree's shadow moves over me.
I stick my stick in the ground.
I sit on a stone.
I rub the mud off my fingers.
This soil is loose; easy to stand in.
I sink my feet a little into the soil.
You're treading on my field.
I tilt my head up toward your boots.
Are you one of the company?
You carry no color at all.

lines.zh: 我把木棍从土里拔出来
lines.en: I pull my stick from the soil.
I'm not much of a soldier.
But I won't run either.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的棍子就放下。
lines.en: Step back, and I lower my stick.
My steps are slower than theirs.
Yet I never fall behind.
You're on the far side of that ditch.
This side of the ditch is mine.
A lump of my clay comes off.
I step back; my foot sinks.
Dry earth falls from my cracks.
I grip my stick harder.

lines.zh: 我身上的棕漆，蹭掉一块。
lines.en: A chip of brown paint came off.
I'm still standing steady.
I wipe the mud off my face.
The line has seen me wounded.
I won't fall back further.
I can hold this field.
Clay doesn't eat this.
Set it down; let me check its color.
I'd rather have leather and sticks.
This is no use to me.
I prefer leather and sticks.
I'm not hungry, nor tempted.
Holding it up looks like you'll hit me.
Put that clay away for now.
I've got work here.
Ask me again later.
The bump presses me into the soil.
I pull my feet out, one by one.
You stepped on my stick.
I bend and pick it up.
That much bumping is nothing.
I step off the ridge.
My clay leaves a print behind.
Your soles are cleaner than mine.
We passed; I gave a salute.
I gave way without fuss.
A soldier like me doesn't speak of it.
Having you in the line is enough.
You lead; I'll bring up the rear.
Dig the same soil and we're companions.
I trust you, though I won't say so.
I can do field work too.
If you're tired, lean on the tree.
I'll keep watch; you sleep.
At dawn we march again.
Don't die in this field.
I pick up a lump of dry clay.
This can patch my cracks.
I press it onto my arm.
I can't move anything heavy.
I pick up a stick.
It'll do.
I stow it behind my belt.
You dropped it? I'll keep it.
A bit of dirt means little.
I slap the mud off my hands.
A noise up ahead.
I lift my head for a look.
That isn't a sound from the line.
I settle my stick in my grip.
The others haven't moved. I'll go first.
Brown-dyed clay, harder than it looks.
I step into a muddy patch.
I pull free and go on.
It's at the far end of the field.

lines.zh: 我棕色的泥身和土一个颜色。
lines.en: This brown clay body matches the soil.
I bring my stick across.
Closer now.
I lower my clay shoulders.
The brown clay of my body has set firm.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，朝它挪过去。
lines.en: Step by halting step, I close in.
The mud slows my feet.
I go around the soft ground.
It backs one step; I follow half.
I glance at my companion.
He circles the other way.
I'm slower here. That's fine.
We have it between us.

lines.zh: 木棍举过我的陶土头顶。
lines.en: I raise my stick above my clay head.

lines.zh: 褐色黏土捏的兵，也能打。
lines.en: A brown clay soldier still fights.
I go for its shin.
This one will land solid.
It raises a hand, so I strike lower.
I come from below.
Now.
My stick hits its ankle.
It buckles and half-kneels.
I pull back and strike again.
There's dirt on my stick.
I move behind it.
It turns; I step back.
My companion is striking too.

lines.zh: 我喘得非常急，泥做的胸口一起一伏。
lines.en: I pant hard; my clay chest heaves.
Even a clay body tires.
I steady and raise the stick.
One swing sends it far back.
I don't chase it out.
This field is mine.
I hold my ground here.
The line is calling me back.
I'm going back.
I'm set down at the field's edge.
My brown clay looks like the soil.

lines.zh: 棕色的手，握起来有点软。
lines.en: Brown hands, a little soft in the grip.
Wet mud still clings to them.
I look up to find the line.
They're at the far end of the field.
I walk over, step by step.
I crush a ridge of earth.

lines.zh: 我这身棕色，是染料染的。
lines.en: This brown coat came from dye.
I stand my stick by my feet.

lines.zh: 我站在这块土上等命令。
lines.en: I stand on this patch of earth awaiting orders.
The wind smells of earth.
The fire turns my clay red.
I fall and sink into loose soil.
The muddy water loosens me.
The blast throws me out of the crater.
An arrow sticks in my leg.
This force is squeezing me.
I don't eat; I only dry and crack.

lines.zh: 雷打进土里，我浑身一麻
lines.en: Lightning runs into the soil; I go numb.
I crumble to earth and keep falling.
